api.title: API
api.tip: Personal tokens let scripts or other apps use your library through the API. A token acts as your account: keep it secret and revoke it when unused.
api.onlyOnce: Copy it now: the token is shown only once.

discord.title: Discord status
discord.tip: Shows “Listening to …” on Discord. A small script has to run on the computer with Discord desktop (nothing to install), because Discord doesn't let servers set your status.
discord.notConfigured: The admin hasn't set a Discord Application ID for this server yet.

discord.desktopHint: Shows what you play on this computer's Discord (Discord must be running).
